sheets.title: Makers’ battery — approved hip-lantern reference
sheets.service: Midjourney in the visible Codex browser
sheets.prompt: Moebius ligne claire comic drawing. Fine black ink outlines, flat pastel colour, sparse hatching on ivory paper. A pocket-sized futuristic power cell worn at the hip: one upright turquoise glass capsule containing lavender liquid, smooth rounded cream ceramic endcaps, two thin brass ribs, discreet rigid belt clip. Broad clean surfaces, gentle strange technology. Single object study.

parameters.no: cables, hoses, handles, gears, filigree, photography, 3d render

sheets.why: The author hearted this original design, explored simpler alternatives, then explicitly chose the earlier original as the final reference. Hip lantern; no tether. Later simplifications do not supersede this selection.
